quest.title: In the Name of the Resistance
quest.description: Your first meeting with the Raiden Shogun leads to a clash beyond your expectations. With a warrant out for you, your only option to reverse the situation now is to throw your lot in with the Sangonomiya resistance.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1125, Primogem x30, Mora x53900, Memory of Violet Flash x1, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Escape from Narukami Island and go to Tatarasuna to find the resistance

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Why have we stopped here?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: In case you've forgotten, the Komore Teahouse is the safest place for me to hide in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: The only thing is, I probably won't be able to leave again for some time. I'll have to leave the next steps to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Go to Tatarasuna and find the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: The Shogun's Army is almost certainly about to issue a warrant for our arrest. There are very few parties that will be willing to shelter us... but the resistance is an exception.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's pretty sure Ayaka mentioned them before... Oh yeah! Sangonomiya's group! The ones who came together to fight the Vision Hunt Decree!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: That's right. The resistance was founded by Sangonomiya Kokomi, the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. Currently, it's her subordinate, Gorou, who leads them in their war against the Shogun's Army.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: However, the Yashiro Commission is not on especially close terms with the resistance. So your dealings with us would normally be frowned upon.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: But you're different, so that shouldn't work against you... As far as I can see, the resistance shouldn't have any reason to turn you away.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: The only issue is that we can't be sure of the resistance forces' current location. You'll have to ask around along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: You'll likely pass through territory occupied by the Shogun's Army at some point. So, be sure to stay on your guard at all times.

choices.text: Be sure you do the same.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Don't worry about me, I can remain hidden when I want to. I won't make it easy for them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We gotta hurry up, the Tenryou Commission could be right around the corner!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's get outta here!

choices.text: I should head off right away.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Me too, well, I should probably head inside the teahouse now. I'll see you when I see you, whenever that is... In the meantime, stay safe.

dialogues.speaker: Takayama
dialogues.text: *yawn* ...I heard they added a couple more people to the wanted list. They're high-priority targets, apparently.

dialogues.speaker: Ishihara
dialogues.text: But most of our forces are out on the front line. How are we supposed to effectively prioritize them? We'll just have to make sure we keep our eyes peeled when we're out on patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Takayama
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder how they're faring on the front line.

dialogues.speaker: Takayama
dialogues.text: The last thing I heard was that we'd pushed the resistance back to just northwest of Musoujin Gorge. I don't know if that's true.

dialogues.speaker: Ishihara
dialogues.text: I doubt it. Their rearguard isn't far from there. We're gaining ground at the moment, but I don't think we've pushed them back that far.

dialogues.speaker: Ishihara
dialogues.text: Anyway, we should focus on patrol. Come on, we're up.

dialogues.speaker: Takayama
dialogues.text: Eh, fair point... *sigh* Time to go to work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The northwest of Musoujin Gorge... So that's where the resistance forces are based. We should keep asking around though, just to be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Sakamoto
dialogues.text: Oh, hey. You managed to escape too?

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: Yeah. Where are you headed?

dialogues.speaker: Sakamoto
dialogues.text: Higi Village. I've heard the rumors, but it's still gotta be a safer place than a warzone.

dialogues.speaker: Sakamoto
dialogues.text: What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: Ugh, don't get me started. I was recuperating on Nazuchi Beach — it's complete chaos over there.

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: The resistance aren't having an easy time of it. They don't have the manpower for an all-out confrontation, so they can't contend with the Shogun's Army.

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: The front line used to be further forward, but they had to retreat a couple of times. Now they're back to Nazuchi Beach.

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: That's where I've just come from — I was lucky to get out. It's much too dangerous... their forces are so scattered that no one knows who's who, and anyone you run into pulls their weapon... I just dropped my luggage and ran here.

dialogues.speaker: Jiichirou
dialogues.text: I think we need to keep moving — things are changing so fast. The further away we can get, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Sakamoto
dialogues.text: Agreed... Why don't we stick together? Can't hurt to team up with someone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nazuchi Beach... Sounds like that's where the resistance and the Shogun's Army are battling it out right now. Let's head over and take a look.

talks.objective: Talk with members of the resistance

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Phew... You saved me. I thought I was about to die.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Thank you so much for your help. I'm Teppei of the Gobius Platoon. I'm with the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I was sent to the front line just recently — I was looking forward to doing my part... Instead, it seems I fell at the first hurdle.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: So, uh... You aren't dressed like resistance fighters — have you come here looking to sign up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Great! Just the other day I heard General Gorou complaining about how desperate we are for more people. Your support will make a big difference.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'll escort you back to our camp... But first, let me bring you up to speed on our current situation.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: As you can see, the resistance are at a constant disadvantage when it comes to open confrontation.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: The goal of the Shogun's Army is to uphold "eternity." To this end, they have the support of the Tenryou Commission's general, Kujou Sara, who commands an exceptionally strong force.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: As for us... Vision bearers are few and far between as it is, and because of the Vision Hunt Decree, they're rarer than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: The fact we're even able to hold out is thanks to the brilliant strategic mind of Her Excellency, Sangonomiya. We're also indebted to the great courage shown by General Gorou and the resistance troops.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I had a Vision myself... Not only would I be better placed to share Her Excellency and General Gorou's burden, but I'd be able to hold my own on the battlefield, too...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but notice that you used elemental energy when saving me just now. You must have a Vision yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{F#She}{M#He}'s a special case! {F#She}{M#He} doesn't have a Vision, but {F#she}{M#he} can control the elements anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Are you serious!? That's... incredible. And I guess that means you're immune to the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: You have to let me introduce you to General Gorou! He'll welcome you with open arms!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Perhaps I can also make a worthy contribution, this way... Of course, I'd much rather prove my worth by the sword. If only taking down Shogunate Samurai was as easy as you make it look.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Anyway, we shouldn't delay. Let's head off!

talks.objective: Go and meet Gorou, the resistance general

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: This is what happened, General Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I was surrounded by Shogunate Samurai, and they came to my rescue.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: They can use the elements without a Vision! The resistance could really use people with that kind of skill. We should bring them in!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm... *clears throat*

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I presume you've heard that the goal of the resistance is to defeat the Shogun's Army and repeal the Vision Hunt Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: This is no easy task. Each who sets foot on the battlefield must be ready to sacrifice their life.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Tell me, why do you wish to join us? The resistance cannot accept any who don't possess a warrior's will — you and I must be certain of your decision.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me tell you about the seizure of the 100th Vision...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: You're referring to the ceremony to mark the 100th Vision seized under the decree, right? Yes, we received some news of it here, despite it taking place over in Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: There was a disturbance, allegedly... Highly unusual, considering that the Raiden Shogun appeared in person...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But why do you wish to discuss this all of a sudden? Unless you have some information to share?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was me.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, we had a fight with the Raiden Shogun and everything. Then, we grabbed the Vision bearer and whisked him off to safety.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After that, they added us to the army's wanted list... That's why we came here.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, we did just recover a bounty notice from a Shogunate Samurai defeated in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: It read "Reward for the capture of a blond-haired traveler and their mysterious flying pet." Hmm... So, this refers to you two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What! Who are they calling a "mysterious flying pet"!?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: My apologies. I understand your situation well enough for now. On behalf of the resistance, welcome to our ranks.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency is currently away from the camp. We don't know where she went, but she instructed us to take care of everything in her absence.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I will ask Teppei here to show you around the camp first, and then dispatch you straight to the front line. If you are ready, of course.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Yes sir.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I used to be in the Logistics Division, so I'm the right person to show you around — I know the setup like the back of my hand.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I'll make sure you get a warm resistance welcome!

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Let's start with the field hospital. Some of my friends are recovering there.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Last time I saw them, I promised that I'd introduce any new recruits. When they're finally back on the battlefield alongside us, we'll all be brothers in arms!

talks.objective: Follow Teppei and help the wounded resistance soldiers

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: *coughing* ...Is this a new recruit?

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Looks like a strong addition to the troop... Hopefully someone I can spar with after I've recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, brand new recruit and your first thought is to start sparring with them? You're getting ahead of yourself. That wound of yours isn't something that's gonna clear up in a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Teppei, did you bring this one in? How are things on the front line?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Aha, well... the enemy are much stronger than we could've imagined, but we're holding our own... I've been right in the thick of it.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: At one point, there were a horde of enemy troops surging towards us like the tide... but I didn't flinch. I drew my blade and charged straight into the fray! Four Shogunate Samurai, and only one of me — but I still managed to fend them off.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Look at you! When did you grow nerves of steel?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: #This {F#lady}{M#guy} stole the show, though. When {F#she}{M#he} saw me tiring and falling back, {F#she}{M#he} burst onto the scene and took down a whole group of them in one fell swoop! They were no match for {F#her}{M#him} at all.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: #I heard {F#she}{M#he} even stormed the Vision Hunt Ceremony... and that the Raiden Shogun herself failed to take {F#her}{M#him} down!

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Amazing work, both of you.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: #Still, uh... I can believe most of that, but {F#her}{M#him} facing off against the Raiden Shogun? I think you might be embellishing the story a little there, Teppei... I mean, we've all heard of the Musou no Hitotachi, right? Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: *sigh* Either way, to tell the truth, with all the losses we've sustained recently, I was starting to lose hope in our ability to hold out much longer.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: But seeing fresh recruits join our ranks and hearing Teppei's exploits... I'm itching to get myself better as soon as possible, so I can get back out on the front line.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Huh, that's a lukewarm epiphany if you ask me. While you're lying there itching to get better, I'm still out there training hard despite my injury... even though it burst open again yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: It did? Well, do you need me to get you something to dress it with?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I heard about a remedy recently that uses wild bugs. All you need to do is grind Onikabuto into powder, and it makes a very effective dressing.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: They say it feels cool on the skin and acts fast to completely cure flesh wounds.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll take one! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Hmm, sounds a little strange to me... I would've thought Wolfhooks would do the trick, but it's your decision.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Well, how about we let our new recruit decide? I'll stay here and make some preparations...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: If you're a fan of weird and wonderful remedies, please gather some Onikabuto for me. I'll take it from there.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: But if you're more of a Wolfhook advocate, bring some of those instead. Personally, I recommend we try the new remedy — it sounds promising!

talks.objective: Give materials that can be used as medicine

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Alright! I knew you'd back me on this!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I can't guarantee it'll work, but if it does, everyone will be fighting fit again in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Why don't you hand me the ingredients — it's a bit of a chore to prepare, so I'll take it from here.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: *grimace* Ow, ow, ow...

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Just like that, the pain's stopped. Now it just feels numb...

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Looks like this might actually work. Not bad, Teppei! As soon as I'm better, we'll have to do some serious sparring together to make up for lost time.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Sparring? You have a one track mind, seriously... But good going, Teppei.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: When you first applied it, it felt like you were rubbing salt into the wound. But then the pain disappeared and there was just a cool sensation. I swear I can feel my body repairing itself already... Still... I better not start overdoing it quite yet.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: I swear I can feel my body repairing itself already... Still... I better not start overdoing it quite yet.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Thanks to both of you for looking after us so well. The day I'm discharged, drinks are on me.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Hehe, just glad we were able to help. Alright, I'm gonna continue giving our new recruit the grand tour. Rest up, you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Don't forget to visit the training grounds! Get some practice in before you hit the front line!

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: *sigh* Calm down and get some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: The training grounds... That reminds me, they should be doing archery training over there right now. Let's head over.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Never mind, I guess this was probably the safer option.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I may need your help in a moment to change their dressings. Here's hoping this'll speed up their recovery.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: And, uh, thanks for your help gathering the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: *grimace* ...This really hurts when you first put it on.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: It's a standard remedy, but a dependable one. More importantly, thanks for the fresh dressing — much appreciated.

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: Hmm... You may have skimped a little here though. I feel like I could use some more!

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: I'm dying to get out of this place! I just want to be back on the battlefield, with you!

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: I don't think it works like that... Piling on extra dressing isn't going to make you heal faster. Especially not when you're sneaking off to go train in the middle of the night! You have to cut that out, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Thanks again, Teppei... and thanks to our new recruit here.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: Speaking of training, that reminds me — they should be doing some archery practice down at the training grounds right now. Why don't you take our new recruit to go check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: It'll be a good chance for them to meet a few more of our platoon and settle in.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: You got it! Alright, let's move out.

talks.objective: Follow Teppei and help the resistance

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: *sigh* Another miss. This sucks...

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: Let's see now... I've loosed exactly ten arrows, and only one—

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: Bullseye?

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: ...Only one hit the target.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: *sigh* This isn't good enough. It's evident from these past few days that practice alone isn't enough to improve our marksmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: How hard could it be? Just draw the bow, aim, and shoot. Clearly I underestimated the skill involved...

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: With progress like this, who knows when we'll be fit for battle. I suppose all we can do for now is wait for the drillmaster's next visit and ask him for more tips.

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: Seems things have gotten tough on the front line recently. All the best drillmasters have already been dispatched to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: I guess we'll just have to keep practicing ourselves. *sigh* At this rate, who knows if we'll ever become resistance fighters...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: C'mon guys! Less complaining, more training...

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: ...Teppei senpai?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Listen up for a second. I've come to introduce our newest recruit.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: #In battle, {F#she}{M#he} single-handedly slayed multiple Shogunate Samurai without so much as breaking a sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: And that was after interrupting the Vision Hunt Ceremony with a feat of stunning bravery, not to mention surviving an encounter with the Raiden Shogun!

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: I—Is that true...? Uh... p—perhaps you'd be willing to give us some... archery tips?

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: We promise not to take too much of your time. A quick demonstration would be all we need. Our previous training was so rushed that we hardly remember the proper technique.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: It would mean a lot!

response.speaker: Shouji
response.text: Oh! Y—You got it! We won't let you down.

choices.text: Sure, but pay attention this time.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'm sure you'll get it this time. Swiftly, now!

talks.objective: Demonstrate archery techniques to the resistance

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Aha, pressure getting to you?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: That's no way to demonstrate. Come on, try again.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Let's go — show us what you got!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Well, there you have it. I told you our latest recruit is pretty strong.

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: Incredible! I think I understand what I was doing wrong now.

dialogues.speaker: Shouji
dialogues.text: My posture was off and I didn't draw back with enough force. Seems I also need to focus on keeping my grip steady and monitoring the external environment. If I can get those few down, I'll be hitting my mark in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: Those "few," huh?

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: Watching your demonstration was a great help. I learned a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: At least this time I was able to observe some proper technique. As long as I can retain it, I know I'll become much stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: Honestly, before this whole conflict came about, I was just another everyday citizen of Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: My wife and I were leading a quiet life together. War and battles were the last things on our minds. That all changed with the Vision Hunt Decree...

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: The actions of the Shogun's Army ignited something inside me — that's why I joined the resistance. The road ahead of us now seems like a long one indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: Can those of us without Visions or combat skills really become adept fighters like them...?

dialogues.speaker: Hisahiko
dialogues.text: ...There's no use in speculating. Thank you both for your help, we'll keep practicing as much as we can.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Stay focused. With us holding the front line, you can continue sharpening your skills until you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Now then, let me show you around some other places.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Where should we head next...

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: Sir! We've got trouble! The Shogun's Army is attacking!

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: There are still many wounded in the camp — we mustn't let the enemy break through! We'll need your help to hold them off!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: What? Impossible! How could they have reached us all the way out here...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: We'd better go assess the situation. A chance for us to prove our worth in battle!

talks.objective: Defeat the Shogunate Army squad attempting a sneak attack

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help! Have you decided which dressing to use yet?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Well, we managed to hold them off... But what would the Shogun's Army be doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: We have sentries and patrols posted all around the perimeter here. The enemy should never have been able to reach us this far unnoticed.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Unless... we have a traitor in our midst.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: They must have an informant feeding them intelligence and helping them to approach unseen. That's the only possible explanation.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Our priority is finding the agent and protecting the camp. This is my chance to show what I'm made of!

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: Sir, if I may...

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: I just returned from inspecting the perimeter. It appears that several portions of our defensive walls were already collapsed.

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: The Shogun's Army must have known about this vulnerability and made their way over from the cliffs nearby, before attacking through the gaps in our defenses.

dialogues.speaker: Message-Runner
dialogues.text: I suggest we repair the walls and double the guard. That should keep them from sneaking up on us like this again.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: In that case... Understood, leave the repairs to us. We can make use of the wood and rope nearby to patch up the defenses.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Why don't we make this more interesting, recruit! A contest between the two of us. Just don't underestimate me, haha! If there's anything I know, it's logistics, you'll see!

talks.objective: Repair the walls around the encampment

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: So you are the only one here? Hm... I thought I might get to meet your grand strategist.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: She is the one that's been causing our forces so much trouble. The fact the resistance has even held out for this long is thanks to her.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: But soon, the resistance will fall. They are no match for the might of the Shogun's Army... Her schemes mean nothing now.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: We have already rooted out those behind the resistance. All who have dishonored the Almighty Shogun will be punished.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I have faith in Her Excellency, and in the soldiers of the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree is a brutal injustice. Our resistance has only just begun!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: ...It is futile. There is one other thing. I'm sure you've seen the recent arrest warrants. I trust that the blond traveler is somewhere among your forces now.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #I will make you a deal. Hand {F#her}{M#him} over to us, and you'll buy yourself some time. A respite from the bloodshed would be advantageous to both sides, would it not?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So that's why you brought reinforcements, just to get—

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #{F#She}{M#He} is of great importance to the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: #But the way I see it, {F#she}{M#he} is expendable to the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #That's where you're wrong — {F#she}{M#he} means just as much to us. As a member of the resistance, {F#she}{M#he}'s a comrade. I'll never surrender {F#her}{M#him} to you.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: "The resistance never betrays its own." Her Excellency made that clear to everyone from the very beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: General Gorou!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Teppei... and the Traveler? What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: *chuckle* It would appear our time to fight side-by-side has finally come...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Well, well... we meet again. This time, I won't let you get away.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I thought that you would seek refuge with the resistance in the hope of receiving asylum.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: That you choose to show up here proves that you have more bravery in you than I had originally thought. And now that you are here, I have a proposal...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Why not represent the resistance in a fight of honor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A "fight of honor"...? What's that?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Before the battle begins, each side chooses their finest warrior for a match of single combat.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: To the superior force, there is little significance in such a duel. But for the weaker force, victory could constitute an important boost to their morale.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Her motives are clear. She wants to use the match as an opportunity to capture you. Do not feel compelled to participate — we can take the fight to them without such a ceremony.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what do you think? Will you fight?

choices.text: It's my duty as a member of the resistance!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Alright, that should do it. The Shogun's Army will have a hard time getting past this, no matter how determined they are!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: It seems I've made another valuable contribution to the resistance... But why does it always have to be logistics work!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I thought getting transferred to the front line would be a chance to showcase my abilities and square off with the enemy. Instead, here I am doing what I've always done before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you so insistent about being on the front line?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: It's just like General Gorou said, we joined the resistance because of our warrior's will.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: There are a multitude of ways to contribute to the resistance, but who wouldn't want to take out a few Shogunate Samurai, given the chance?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Anyway, we got more than we bargained for inspecting the camp! Let's report back to General Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: If all goes well, we might just be assigned a few missions closer to the action!

talks.objective: Go back and report the situation to Gorou

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Strange, I don't see General Gorou anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Kaida Ryouma
dialogues.text: We've had a change of plans. The general has been dispatched to the front line to lead our forces into battle.

dialogues.speaker: Kaida Ryouma
dialogues.text: The Shogun's Army is attempting an advance on the main front. Reports have it that Kujou Sara is now personally leading the enemy forces.

dialogues.speaker: Kaida Ryouma
dialogues.text: As for us... It's been days since Her Excellency last made an appearance here. We've executed almost all the directives she gave us, but have received no further instruction.

dialogues.speaker: Kaida Ryouma
dialogues.text: The situation is becoming grim... If we retreat any further, I fear morale may falter.

dialogues.speaker: Kaida Ryouma
dialogues.text: For now, we can only pray that General Gorou will be able to turn the tide... however difficult that may seem.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: We should go to the front line.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Our forces need all the help they can get — we're no use to them here.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: We mustn't let Tatarasuna fall to the enemy!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Stronger than I anticipated... This contest has served its purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Soldiers, attack!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Prepare to engage!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: All of you, with me!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #Greetings, {NICKNAME}. This is the first time we've met, please allow me to introduce myself.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I am Sangonomiya Kokomi, organizer of the resistance, and also the Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's the first time you're hearing that title... To put it simply, I'm the person currently in charge on Watatsumi Island, which is also the home front of the resistance.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I've actually heard all about you from Beidou and Kazuha. I hadn't expected to find you'd joined the resistance, though.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Do you have a plan beyond this point?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No immediate plans...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Mm... in that case, shall we continue our conversation at the shrine of Sangonomiya?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Although the Shogun's Army has retreated for now, the war is far from over.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree has not been repealed, and neither the Tenryou Commission nor the Raiden Shogun show any sign of stopping... In short, our problems have yet to be resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I suggest we move to the shrine to discuss our counter-plan. What say you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Um... Can I come, too?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I know Watatsumi Island very well. I can carry on being your guide, if you'd like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course you can come.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Gorou, thank you for all you have done.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Our forces are weaker than the Shogun's Army, and my absence can only have made the recent days all the more trying for you.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I must still ask you to stay a while longer, to keep eyes on the Shogun's Army and also to see to the wounded. Mm... But I will ask the mercenaries to remain stationed here, and Kazuha is here too. Hopefully, this will serve to reduce the pressure you are under.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Well received, Your Excellency!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #...I must return to Sangonomiya now, I have a few things to attend to... Once you're ready, {NICKNAME}, please rendezvous with Teppei. He will escort you there.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Thank you for all your efforts so far. From this day on, I fight alongside you.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Fight... for the future of Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I guarantee you, only the Alcor could pull off an ambush as quietly as that.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Did we give you a fright? I gotta admit, I was caught off guard myself. When we dropped you off in Ritou, I wasn't expecting Tatarasuna would be the next place I'd see you.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But wherever you might end up, you'll always be part of Captain Beidou's crew.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: If you're ever in a tight spot, come and find me. I'll have your back.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: On the way here, I happened to learn of the bounty on your head. Hehe, as expected, you seem to have given them quite the challenge in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I hear also that you witnessed the Raiden Shogun? I trust she's as oppressive as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Musou no Hitotachi... Are there truly those who can withstand it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Perhaps one day, we will be able to face her oppression head-on... This is the reason I returned to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency never fails us!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I must say, I was certainly surprised to look out and see Kazuha joining the fray. It's been quite some time since we last fought side-by-side...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: At that time, his friend was defeated in a duel before the throne... and executed by the Raiden Shogun. Kazuha came to visit the resistance as he was fleeing Inazuma with his friend's Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: ...Hard to believe it's been so long.

dialogues.speaker: Tokuda
dialogues.text: I wonder when I'll finally be back on the front line...

dialogues.speaker: Masashi
dialogues.text: No one wants the Vision Hunt Decree. The resistance will be victorious!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! D'you think that's a resistance fighter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like he's in a tight spot... Let's go help him out!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Remove all threats to Eternity — by order of the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Be wary, you're up against a powerful opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: You can take 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's more than one round! Keep it up!

dialogues.speaker: Resistance Fighters
dialogues.text: Look! That's two rounds in a row!

dialogues.speaker: Resistance Fighters
dialogues.text: The Shogun's Army is not invincible! We can win!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The soldiers are rallying... Your warrior's will is bringing them hope, Traveler...
